envelope.description: Divided-versus-single equivalence and failure through runCodeReview

body.title: Divided-versus-single equivalence and failure through runCodeReview
body.summary: Integration tests drive a divided review end to end through runCodeReview with a small limit and scripted answers keyed by stage and callId, and compare it with the same material in one call under a raised limit, on fixtures that fit both ways.
acceptanceChecks: A divided review and the same material in one call under a raised limit give the same obligation verdicts for every dimension.
A caller and callee in different chunks whose contract disagrees are reported at the caller through runCodeReview.
Two duplicate symbols in different chunks are reported with counterpartRef through runCodeReview.
A degraded review whose single call is over the limit is divided with zero atoms and judges every promised test at gather on its full record evidence.
A gather call failing twice fails the review and records nothing (runCodeReview returns ok: false).
Every call the divided review sends measures within the limit.
